name: Esufey Speed
body:
Your wings are powerful, allowing you to fly swiftly.

Prerequisite(s): Esufey Wings, character level 11th, esufey.

Benefit: Your fly speed granted by your wings increases to 40 feet (good maneuverability) if you’re wearing light armor and unencumbered, or 30 feet (average maneuverability) with a medium or heavy load or medium or heavy armor.
